content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** LOL-CAP — **deviation** (Section 15, ¶p0104–p0105).

- Section 15 gives only a *mutual* exclusion of special/indirect/consequential damages and limits recovery to direct damages; the last sentence lifts that limitation for Sections 13 (IP indemnity) and 14 (confidentiality).
- No aggregate monetary cap exists anywhere in the Agreement (searches for "liability", "exceed", "fees payable" returned nothing else; "Fees" is undefined and simply payable under the Fee Schedule), so direct-damages exposure is unlimited for both sides, and neither "gross negligence" nor "wilful misconduct" appears in the document.
- Cure targeted at the **fallback**: one inserted sentence pair in Section 15 imposing a mutual cap at 12 months' fees paid or payable by Sparkling, plus a gross negligence / wilful misconduct carve-out. Because the retained sentence disapplies "the limitation of liability in this Section 15" to Sections 13 and 14, the indemnification and confidentiality carve-outs automatically reach the new cap — so those two elements were mapped as already met rather than restated.
- No double-flagging with INDEMN; preferred extras (USD 1m floor, data protection/security, fraud, IP infringement, payment-obligations exclusion) noted in the rationale only.
